summary: Alcoa filed an 8-K after pricing $2.6B of senior notes, split as $1.5B 6.625% notes due 2034 by Alumina Pty Ltd and $1.1B 6.875% notes due 2036 by Alcoa Nederland Holding B.V., both guaranteed by Alcoa and subsidiaries. Settlement is expected September 23, 2026. Net proceeds plus cash on hand fund the $3.1B cash consideration for Alcoa's previously announced acquisition of South32's bauxite, alumina and aluminum smelter interests, intended as permanent financing. Watch deal regulatory clearances, notes closing conditions and financing-market execution risk against the pending South32 transaction.
